## About
The Diesel Shop, also known as TDS Miami, is a family-owned diesel truck shop on NW 88th Ave in Doral. Enrique Gonzalez runs it with his son Jesus, and the shop specializes in turbo diesel high performance for Duramax, Power Stroke and Cummins.
Some folks come in for routine service and tune-ups. Others come for tuning, lift kits and full performance builds. Clients come from all over Florida and beyond, including Texas, Georgia, New York and even Canada.
Enrique likes doing things his own way. His shop truck, the D-max Colorado, is a diesel-powered mid-size truck built to be driven daily, raced and shown. It has run races across the United States and has been featured in magazines.

## Services
- Diagnostics: Accurate diagnostics for Chevy, Ford and Dodge diesel trucks.
- Preventative maintenance: Regular preventative maintenance for your diesel truck.
- Tuning packages: Tuning packages for trucks that live on the street or the track.
- High-performance builds: High-performance builds backed by the shop's extensive experience.
- Suspension lift kits: Suspension lift kits that clear bigger tires without giving up ride quality.
- Air suspension: Air suspension that lets you choose a softer ride on rough roads or a firmer one for better handling.
- Train horns: Train horn installation for drivers who want something louder.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday to Friday, 7 am to 5 pm. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Which trucks do you work on?
A: We work on diesel trucks, including Chevy Duramax, Ford Powerstroke and Dodge Cummins.

Q: Do you offer a discount for veterans, police or firefighters?
A: One customer wrote that they received a 10% veteran, police and firefighter discount. Give us a call to ask about it.
